goal: Prevent deadlocks from recursive locking and re-entrant callbacks in descriptor wallets
Clarify the wallet locking hierarchy by making descriptor manager synchronization private
agreement: Support for splitting into self-locking public methods and lock-held helpers (pablomartin4btc)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it improves internal wallet locking safety without changing user-facing behavior
Advances the broader project effort to eliminate recursive mutexes across the codebase
Prevents potential deadlocks when synchronous listeners query descriptor state
